summary: Full backend + frontend retest of the 35-product Nutri-Aahar catalogue, the new Atta & Flours category, product detail conditional rows, all four enquiry types (with empty RESEND_API_KEY), and footer contact details. 27/27 pytest API tests pass; all Playwright UI flows pass. No functional defects found; only minor taxonomy/UX observations reported.

minor.issue: No per-product endpoint exists. ProductDetail fetches the full 35-item catalogue and filters client-side; while loading it briefly renders the 'Product not found' empty state for valid slugs (visible flash on slow networks).

send_enquiry_email is launched via bare asyncio.create_task without holding a reference (risk of GC cancellation) and enquiry_type is a free-form string with no enum validation (accepted 'TEST_quote'). Non-blocking.

issues: Separate 'Dry Fruits' and 'Dates' cards/filters both resolve to the identical 4 products (Dates, Almonds, Cashews, Raisins) because the API aliases both to 'Dates & Dry Fruits' — duplicate results look like a bug to users. Consider one 'Dates & Dry Fruits' entry.

action_items: Optional: de-duplicate the Dates / Dry Fruits category labels into a single 'Dates & Dry Fruits' entry on homepage grid and /products filter row.
Optional: add a loading state to ProductDetail so valid slugs never flash 'Product not found', or add GET /api/products/{slug}.
Optional: keep a strong reference to the create_task email task and constrain enquiry_type with an Enum/Literal.
critical_code_review_comments: Category taxonomy is still duplicated between App.js and server.py with an alias hack ('Dates'/'Dry Fruits' -> 'Dates & Dry Fruits') in get_products; a single source of truth (e.g. GET /api/categories) would prevent future silent filter mismatches.
asyncio.create_task(send_enquiry_email(...)) result is discarded — task exceptions are swallowed and the task can be garbage collected.
seed_data_creation: Created 8 TEST enquiries via API (quote/b2b/export/contact) and 4 TEST enquiries via UI forms; collection now holds 22 docs. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: GET /api/products returns exactly 35 with counts Whole Spices=13, Makhana=6, Atta & Flours=6, Dates & Dry Fruits=4, Spice Powders=3, Seeds & Specialty=3; unique slugs; Dates/Dry Fruits aliases both return the 4 Dates & Dry Fruits items; unknown category -> []; new slugs (wheat-atta, besan-gram-flour, ragi/bajra/jowar/soyabean-atta, roasted-cheese-makhana, star-anise, raw-makhana) present with valid image URLs. POST /api/enquiries returns 200 for all 4 types, persists (verified via GET, no _id leakage), missing fields -> 422; backend log shows 11x 'Email notification skipped: RESEND_API_KEY not configured' with zero send failures. UI: homepage 6 category cards (incl. Atta & Flours, Seeds & Specialty excluded), footer testids correct (info.ashirwadt@gmail.com, Sarjapur Bangalore 560035, Gaya Bihar 823001, Delivery PAN India), /products renders 35 cards with 0 broken images, filters Atta & Flours=6, Makhana=6, Dates=4, Whole Spices=13, Seeds=3; detail pages render conditional Uses & benefits / Nutrition / Shelf life / Available form rows; quote prefill from product page works; quote/b2b/export/contact forms all POST 200 and show success card + toast; mobile 390px has 0 horizontal overflow and working menu.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking issue. The previous iteration's Dates/Dry Fruits filter bug is fixed via alias mapping in get_products plus matching client-side fallback in Products(); side effect is two UI labels returning the same result set.
